requirement: Collect, organize and analyze a full list of requirements
note: All 24 requirements tracked with a status and evidence pointer.

requirement: Suggest improvements to the site to improve decision-making
note: 12 ranked suggestions, each with cost, evidence and the decision it unlocks.

requirement: Create a dedicated Suggestions section so a reviewer can choose a path before implementing
note: Ranked board with gate (adopt now / needs data / do not adopt) and review owner.

requirement: Clear list of questions, information and answers needed before a decision
note: 16 open questions, each with what we HAVE, what we LACK, and the answer format required.

requirement: Originate my own NFL lines
note: A reproducible line-origination model (Elo -> spread/total) exists and is priced against real closes. It is NOT yet an independent line: it uses only result history, and its disagreement with the market is inside the market's own error band (see Q-LINE-02).

requirement: Research and develop strategies for generating useful signals
note: 15 pre-registered signal families tested walk-forward over 2006-2026.

requirement: Treat it as a leaderboard competition with rewards for top strategies
note: Reward only released if all 7 gates pass. On current evidence zero strategies qualify, so zero reward is paid. This is the honest outcome, not a failure of the leaderboard.

requirement: Cover single bets, parlays, and player prop bet combos
note: Singles and parlays fully measured. Player props are NOT measurable here: no prop-level dataset was obtainable (FLAG-01) -> OQ-PROP-01.

requirement: Each strategy must pass validation gates
note: Seven gates, all pre-registered before results were seen.

requirement: Determine correlation values
note: Measured with bootstrap CIs on 5,336 games.

requirement: Remove luck from the equation
note: Multiple-testing deflation, Wilson intervals and a no-single-season-dependency gate are in place. Luck cannot be fully removed from a finite sample; the gates bound it.

requirement: Build strategies that are selectively skill-based
note: No candidate survived. The closest (WIND15_UNDER, WIND_COLD_UNDER, DIV_AWAY_DOG) all failed significance or stability.

requirement: Track injuries
note: Current week is hand-verified from NFL.com. History is 2025 only because the release CDN is blocked. A 2026 backfill is OQ-06.

requirement: Know deficiencies when 2nd/3rd/4th string replace starters on defence
note: The official roster feed has no depth order and nflverse depth_charts is unreachable. Only QB changes are attributable from game data. Nothing is inferred.

requirement: Same for offences using starters vs backups
note: QB only, and only as 'different starter' (start-sequence rank), never as a claimed depth-chart slot.

requirement: Create an executive summary
note: One page, numbers only, every claim linked.

requirement: No manual input from the owner
note: Every artefact is produced by a script from pinned inputs (data/raw/MANIFEST.json).

requirement: Verify line by line from official/trusted sources with links
note: All 345 Week-10 rows carry the official URL and a verbatim quote. Rows that could not be confirmed are blank and listed in data/unverified.csv.

requirement: Flag irregularities for review
note: 9 flagged items, each with impact and the fix required.

requirement: Create a GitHub Pages site with a clean landing page and category subpages
note: Static, no build step, no external JS or fonts.

requirement: All entries and findings in simple tables with analysis
note: Every table is generated from a CSV in data/ by scripts/build_site.py.

requirement: Every table row must link to an official source, else blank + flagged
note: Enforced by scripts/verify_site.py, which fails the build on a row without a source.

requirement: Coordinate with parallel sessions via COORDINATION.md
note: Board claimed, scopes recorded, all claims and handoffs logged.

requirement: Open a PR, merge it, and confirm GitHub Pages deploys
note: Recorded in the log after merge.
